lessons_used: Predictions generally overestimate noise-corrected results, though winning tests frequently exceed expected gains.
Choose_path hints showed no clear positive effect or degraded performance across four tests.

Home wait_info changes mostly showed no clear effect across nine tests, yielding only one winning test.

Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once, while outcomes remain inconsistent for sign_in copy, sign_in reorder, sign_in redesign, adoption redesign, adoption new_screen, choose_path layout, finish hint, and finish redesign.

candidates.title: Place sign-in before adoption certificate creation
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after pet selection/upload and prior to generating the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion is 80.0% with a long mean duration (567s); placing sign-in directly before formal pet adoption connects account creation directly with finalizing pet ownership.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in step inside onboarding is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in step has 20% drop-off, but reordering showed only +0.3% historical lift across 4 tests.

candidates.title: Interactive pet desktop visibility check screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated desktop visibility verification screen right before the final home introduction screen.
candidates.why: Support logs show multiple reports of pets failing to render on desktop or app failing to launch properly.

new_visibility_check.headline: Desktop Visibility Verification
new_visibility_check.body: Please verify your pet is currently visible on your desktop screen.

components.label: I see my pet on screen

guard.reason: Adding a new verification screen before home_intro within onboarding is permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Home drop-off is low (9.8%); adding a new screen increases friction without strong precedent.

candidates.title: Split layout story intro screen redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story screen into a split layout layout separating the background lore from path selection highlights.
candidates.why: The choose_path funnel step shows a high mean duration (514s vs 8s median), indicating users stall on reading narrative content.

story.headline: Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion
story.body: Choose how you want to bring your pet to life on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout while preserving pet introduction functionality is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Funnel shows time stall, but choose_path redesigns historically yielded negative results (-1.2%).

candidates.title: Interactive desktop controls checklist on finish screen
candidates.change: Add an interactive control guide checklist component on the home_intro screen showing core desktop hotkeys and mouse actions.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints after onboarding regarding how to hide, control, or interact with the pet.

candidates.change: Update the home intro text to explicitly detail how to control, hide, and interact with the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support tickets show user confusion after setup about controlling, hiding, or talking to the desktop pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Active on Your Desktop!

guard.reason: Updating text copy on the home_intro screen inside onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: High support email volume confirms user confusion; simple copy change on high drop-off finish step.

candidates.title: Account persistence sign-in provider hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen prompting returning users to sign in with their original provider to prevent pet resets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different account.

sign_in.hint: Returning user? Sign in with the exact same provider account to access your saved pet.

guard.reason: Adding a sign-in provider hint to the sign_in screen is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: 8 support emails directly document account reset issues; config-only hint fix.

candidates.title: Split layout for adoption certificate screen
candidates.change: Change adoption certificate layout to split view side-by-side display.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 78.7% conversion rate and median duration of 89s; split view provides cleaner visual separation between certificate data and preview.

guard.reason: Changing the layout of the adoption certificate screen is permitted under Rules 2 and 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption layout changes consistently degraded performance (-2.3% across 2 tests).

candidates.title: Desktop launch troubleshooting tip on waiting screen
candidates.change: Display a helpful tip on the waiting screen explaining what to check if the pet window does not open automatically.
candidates.why: Support received reports of pets not showing on desktop or the app stalling before first view.

waiting.hint: If your pet does not appear on screen within a few seconds, check your system tray or taskbar.

guard.reason: Adding troubleshooting tips to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Support mentions app stalling, but 9 prior wait_info tests show minimal average lift (+0.6%).

candidates.title: Photo upload guidance hint for custom pet creation
candidates.change: Add photo selection quality guidelines as a hint on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: Support received complaints about custom pet creation failing or yielding unexpected visual results.

upload_photos.hint: Upload clear, well-lit photos with a single subject facing forward for best results.

guard.reason: Adding a photo upload guidance hint to upload_photos is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses reported custom pet creation errors with a low-cost hint configuration.

candidates.change: Redesign choose_path screen to a carousel layout to showcase path options in a clear visual sequence.

guard.reason: Redesigning the choose_path screen layout to a carousel is allowed under Rules 2 and 4.

candidates.score_note: High mean time on choose_path, but redesigns and hints historically perform poorly on this step.
